label: Mode-of-being sentence and subsistent esse: middle terms, the act of being and the quantifier view
summary: Warrant-phase checkpoint 3 on the ST I q.4 a.2 sentence 'omnium autem perfectiones pertinent ad perfectionem essendi' (5c5281dd), read with objection 3, the second proof, ad 3 and q.4 a.1 ad 3 in the materialized SCTA witnesses. The ground, as a necessary condition, gives the dependence reading; Aquinas uses it for the constitutive reading. Ad 3's first clause undercuts objection 3; its reason clause states the formal-or-eminent whole-power sibling 9a0a4951 (claim 1c66ee49), which supports d164b1ff. Both premise pairs are equivalent to their composites when existentially closed over the primitive (general Barbara fact, certified). New senses: MODE_OF_BEING (8eb007a6) and PERFECTION_OF_BEING (62ca3d65). The act-of-being thesis is split into R-act1 (8c64b036) and R-act2 (254ee26f); controls certify that R-act1 with the reception and purity interfaces does not give R-act2. The quantifier view stands unresolved, comparison not run.
blocker: Beyond the dependence reading both loci rest on R-act2 (intensive esse), and the route to OwnBeing on R-act1; no bridge from R-act1 to R-act2 and no formalized inference from dependence to either is on file, and the explanatory comparison with the quantifier view has not been run. Next: formalize the q.4 a.1 ad 3 'unde' inference from dependence to R-act and locate its missing bridge.

current_assessment.scope: The q.4 a.2 sentence 5c5281dd in its three registered readings (dependence 196e6606/7067553d, mode 791fa216 with primitive ModeOfBeing, pure perfection c4fb87a6 with primitive OfBeing), the transfer pair 791fa216 and 2f6b9eff, and the subsistent-esse pair d164b1ff and c4fb87a6, under the shared GradesFrame and the WholePowerPerfection vocabulary. Repaired after challenge: the act-of-being thesis split into R-act1 (8c64b036, received and limited esse) and R-act2 (254ee26f, intensive esse); the ad 3 claim on the formal-or-eminent sibling 9a0a4951.
current_assessment.assessment: Read as a necessary condition, the sentence's ground yields the dependence reading, which every rival grants; on it 791fa216 carries no load and the whole transfer load sits on 2f6b9eff (certified). Aquinas uses the ground for the constitutive reading ('secundum hoc ... quod', 'unde sequitur', the 'unde' of q.4 a.1 ad 3); whether it warrants that reading turns on the unformalized inference from dependence to an act-of-being thesis. Each pair, existentially closed over its primitive, is equivalent to its composite (certified; a general fact about Barbara decompositions). That the decompositions shift the load rather than lighten it is a judgment resting on the absence of any fixing of the primitive independent of the act-of-being theses; on the act reading 2f6b9eff is near-analytic. Beyond dependence the loci rest on two theses counted separately: R-act1 (received, limited esse; heading a shared-warrant cluster of logically distinct, conditional or negative members, of which the route premise 29e71e43 assumes part) and R-act2 (intensive esse; identical with c4fb87a6 in the act sense). The R-act1 to R-act2 bridge is missing; the controls certify non-entailment on the stated interfaces, from the vocabulary alone; the candidate bridge is the q.7 a.1 family (unreceived esse is unlimited, so it includes every pure perfection). Objection 3 as stated is undercut by ad 3's first clause without R-act; its residual form ('ipsum esse is ens tantum') is the quantifier view's claim and is answered only by the second clause. The quantifier view is the strongest surviving rival; its standing is unresolved and the comparison has not been run, with an asymmetry recorded: R-act1 has positive warrant on file, R-act2 textual warrant, and the rival's distinctive claim none. At locus (b) the bundle {OwnBeing(s), d164b1ff in the PERFECTION_OF_BEING_2 sense (real Has), R-act2, purity of wisdom (44e39691), not Has(s, wisdom)} is inconsistent (forward direction of ownBeingPairIffEveryPure); rejecting one member is forced, none in particular. Keeping 9a0a4951 while rejecting real Has is an open logical option with no defender on file: R-act2 makes at most 'not lacking' a meaning postulate, not real having. The theistic content of locus (b) is conditional on all four members, purity being stipulative, and reaching intellect needs the further open capacity, exercise, grounding and recognition premises of the route through fe67d766 (results fd01e30c and c256d381, PR #2162). Ad 3 states the formal-or-eminent sibling 9a0a4951; d164b1ff stays supported, as with SCG I.28. First grades; no earlier judgment is revised.
current_assessment.next_test: Formalize the q.4 a.1 ad 3 'unde' inference from the dependence reading (7067553d) to R-act1 and to R-act2, locate the weakest bridge for each, and test whether the quantifier view, which grants dependence, can reject that bridge only by rejecting the act of being itself.

assessment_history.scope: The q.4 a.2 sentence 5c5281dd in its three registered readings (dependence 196e6606/7067553d, mode 791fa216 with primitive ModeOfBeing, pure perfection c4fb87a6 with primitive OfBeing), the transfer pair 791fa216 and 2f6b9eff, and the subsistent-esse pair d164b1ff and c4fb87a6, under the shared GradesFrame and the WholePowerPerfection vocabulary.
assessment_history.assessment: The sentence's own ground supports only the dependence reading, which every rival grants, and on that reading 791fa216 carries no load: the whole transfer load sits on 2f6b9eff (certified). Each premise pair is its composite with a primitive middle term (certified), so the decompositions shift the load and add no warrant: their warrant is that of 'a total cause of being causes every actual perfection' and 'whatever is its own being has every pure perfection'. What the two loci say beyond the dependence reading rests on the act-of-being thesis (q.4 a.1 ad 3: esse is the actuality of all things, even of forms; q.3 a.4), which is the same commitment as the reception and participation framework and the real-distinction premises and must be counted once. The strongest rival, the quantifier view, grants the dependence reading and the form of d164b1ff, denies the act of being and c4fb87a6 for life and wisdom, and conflicts with no accepted floor item; on current evidence the standing is parity. Within the act-of-being thesis, the subsistent-esse locus excludes an impersonal source that is its own being. d164b1ff is now stated by ad 3. First grades; no earlier judgment is revised.
assessment_history.next_test: Assess the act-of-being thesis itself: the q.3 a.4 first proof and De ente c.4 against a defended reduction of the act of being to instantiation, or an explanatory comparison of limitation by received act against limitation by essential content.
